explanation: I grepped Mathlib for `ordCompl` together with `primeFactors`, and for `primeFactors_ordCompl` and `primeFactors_div*`. I found no lemma about `(ordCompl[p] n).primeFactors`. The nearest result is `Nat.factorization_ordCompl`, which says `(ordCompl[p] n).factorization = n.factorization.erase p`. That is the lemma the current proof rewrites with. Turning it into the `primeFactors` statement still takes several rewrites: `support_factorization`, `Finsupp.support_erase`, and `support_factorization` again. So it is not a one- or two-line special case.
